conventions.profile: 256 bytes, Unity box frame: origin at the centre of the base, +Y up, i along local +X, j along local +Z, index j * 16 + i, row 0 at the lowest z, 0 = no hit, else clamp(floor(255 * y / h + 0.5), 1, 255); hits below 0.02 m or above h + 0.05 m and Floor-class triangles do not count (ObjectProfile.cs, profile.py of_mesh). Profiles are standard base64 with padding.
conventions.rotate: rotate(p, k) is ObjectProfile.Rotate(p, k): new cell (i, j) takes old cell (j, 15 - i) for k = 1, (15 - i, 15 - j) for k = 2, (15 - j, i) for k = 3.
conventions.quarterTurn: A quarter turn k of a prop mesh is the turn whose profile is rotate(profile, k): in Unity's frame (x, y, z) -> (-z, y, x), applied k times (cleanup._YAW90 in the GLB frame). The prop's size turns with it: odd k gives (d, h, w). scale[*].fittedProfile, of_mesh of the fitted mesh at its own extent (extentOut), equals rotate(profile, k) in every scale vector.
conventions.scale: lambda_k = ln(box_k / e_k) with e the turned mesh's extent, u = exp(mean lambda), s_k = u * clip(exp(lambda_k) / u, 1 - a, 1 + a), a = 0.15; then the origin moves to the centre of the base. The result's extent is extentOut, not box, when the clip acts.
conventions.fitScore: fit_score(scan, generated): mean over the cells the scan saw (scan != 0) of |generated - scan| / 255.
conventions.matcher: Candidates: props of the query's category. Turns: {0} for Profile and Clearance, {0,1,2,3} for Box and Table. e = prop size turned (odd turns swap w and d); lambda_k = ln(size_k / e_k); A = mean_k |lambda_k - mean(lambda)|. F = fit_score(q.profile, rotate(prop.profile, turn)) when coverage(q.profile) >= 0.30, else 0 (a null profile has coverage 0). tags = min(0.06, 0.03 * the number of distinct strings in both tag lists, ordinal). Score = F + 0.5 A - tags. Tie: every candidate with score - lowest < 0.02 is tied; among them the smaller turn wins, then the ordinal-smaller id. expected.index is the index in matcher.library. found = false when no prop has the category.
conventions.tolerance: Floats are compared within 1e-4; choices (found, index, id, quarterTurns) and profile bytes exactly.
